title: What if your cat became a skinwalker in the middle of the night?
style: what-if-video-stil v2 (soft look), no narration – text + sound only

lines.text: What if your cat became a skinwalker in the middle of the night?
3:00 AM. Your cat is asleep at the end of your bed.
But your cat is right here.
She's staring at the door. Not blinking.
Something out there is copying her voice.
Then she slowly turns to look at you.
And something tall is standing in the hallway.
It's purring. It looks just like her.
So who is still standing in the doorway?
Which one is your real cat?
